newsitem.title: UK: BG gains on hopes for MMC report.
newsitem.headline: BG gains on hopes for MMC report.

text.p: Shares in BG Plc rose in active trade on Tuesday, amid hopes the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) is about to decide in favour of BG in its dispute with gas industry regulator Ofgas, analysts said.
By 1430 GMT, BG shares were up 10-1/2p to 215-1/2p, its highest since its demerger earlier this year, in volume of 17.4 million shares -- making it the third most active stock in London.
"It seems to be clear now that the MMC will decide in favour of BG", one analyst said.

The Sunday Telegraph reported on June 1 the MMC report, which is due in mid-June, had dashed plans by Ofgas director-general Clare Spottiswoode to enforce cuts in the annual average domestic gas bill by altering the rate at which BG can depreciate its assets.

A High Court ruling today in favour of the Central Area Transmission System (CATS) also supported the stock, dealers said. BG, which has a 51.18 stake in CATS would receive an additional payment of 50 million pounds, the company said in a statement.
BG is the renamed rump of British Gas, following the demerger of its gas supply arm into a new company four months ago.
